attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) – Occupational Therapy Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses relevant to OT with stated learning objectives, from accredited colleges, state/federal agencies, OT professional associations or facilities, or commercial CE providers; blocks of at least 50 minutes. Formats: college lecture, conferences, seminars, training sessions, synchronous or asynchronous distance learning, authoring peer-reviewed articles/books/chapters, volunteer board/committee/leadership service, studying peer-reviewed articles (limits per format in R156-42a-304); Level II student supervision may count.
rules.alternatives: Current and active NBCOT certification may replace the 24 hours, but the 2 hours of legal and ethical principles are still required.
rules.audit_note: Completion is verified by certificates of course completion kept by the licensee (R156-42a-304).

topics.who: Legal and ethical principles of practice; required even when renewing with NBCOT certification

rules.legal_basis: Utah Code §58-42a-303.5; Utah Admin. Code R156-42a-304
rules.notes: Licenses expire May 31 of odd-numbered years (2-year cycle). A proposed amendment to R156-42a (OAR File No. 58418, comment period to 12/15/2026) restates the same CE structure (2 h legal/ethical + 24 h or NBCOT).
